🖨️ RawBT Example 04 - Barcode Printing

📌 Note: Barcode printing requires a compatible thermal printer that supports ESC/POS barcode commands.

Supported Barcode Types:

Type Description Example Data
CODE128 Most versatile, alphanumeric ABC123
EAN13 13-digit product codes 5901234123457
EAN8 8-digit product codes 96385074
UPC_A 12-digit US product codes 012345678905
CODE39 Alphanumeric industrial CODE39
ITF Interleaved 2 of 5 1234567890

Basic Usage:

// Simple barcode job.barcode('123456789', 'CODE128'); // With options job.barcode('123456789', 'CODE128', { width: 2, // 1-6 (barcode width) height: 60, // Height in dots position: 2 // 0=none, 1=above, 2=below, 3=both });
